ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel values covering approximately 92-95% of the surface area, with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white/yellowish) pixels localized primarily at the tips and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base surface consists of contiguous dark-grey and black pixel values. High-contrast yellowish-white contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal extremities (left and right tips). Small, isolated, high-intensity white circular blobs are non-uniformly distributed across both lobes, with a specific cluster near the central-lower peduncle attachment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees, with a bounding-box depth extending significantly into the fluke center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys; serration is most pronounced on the distal thirds of the trailing edge, transitioning to a smoother contour near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the leading edges, tapering into sharply defined, upward-sweeping distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least 12 discrete, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters; higher concentration observed on the medial and distal regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, unaligned linear pixel disruption of lighter-grey intensity is visible on the upper-mid section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, high-contrast, textured yellowish-white clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on both distal tips and segments of the trailing edges. Multiple circular depigmented scars (likely parasitic lesions) distributed across the dark field.
other_distinctive_markers: The density of barnacle colonization at the distal tips creates a unique, irregular bulbous silhouette that alters the expected smooth geometric curve of the extremities.
